signs.title: The Rubicon
signs.body:
Beyond this stream
lies Italia herself.
Cross under arms and
there is no return.

signs.title: The Via Appia
signs.body:
The Appian Way runs
south to Brundisium
and the sea.

signs.title: Roma
signs.body:
All roads lead here.
Emperor Traianus holds
court within.

signs.title: The Apennines
signs.body:
This stony spine
divides the peninsula,
coast from coast.

signs.title: The Strait
signs.body:
Across the water lies
Sicilia, granary of
the Republic.

signs.title: Alesia
signs.body:
Here Vercingetorix
laid down his arms
before Caesar.

signs.title: The Rhine
signs.body:
This river marks the
edge of the world.
Beyond it, Germania.

signs.title: Britannia
signs.body:
Across the northern
sea lies Britannia,
and Londinium upon it.

signs.title: Carthago
signs.body:
Thrice Rome fought
her; thrice she fell.
Carthago delenda est.

signs.title: The Sahara
signs.body:
South lies the sand.
A day of marching
buys a single tile.

signs.title: The Grain Fleet
signs.body:
From these ports the
corn ships sail to
feed a million in Roma.

signs.title: Palmyra
signs.body:
Oasis of the caravans,
where Zenobia named
herself Augusta.

signs.title: The Frontier
signs.body:
East lies Parthia,
the border Rome
never truly held.

signs.title: The Silk Road
signs.body:
The road from the East
ends here. Its wealth
passes through Antiochia.

dialog.body:
Emperor Traianus bids you
welcome, Hero.

Return with the stolen Aquila
of the Legions and all the
provinces of Rome are yours.

audience.intro:
Trumpets announce your
arrival with imperial fanfare.

Emperor Traianus rises from his
throne to greet you and
proclaims:           (space)
audience.rank_up:
Congratulations %NAME%,

I now raise you to the rank of
%RANK%.
audience.more_needed:
My dear %NAME%,

I can aid you better after
you've captured %NEEDED% more
villains.
audience.final_rank:
%NAME% the %RANK%,

Hurry and recover the Aquila
of the Legions, or all Rome
will be lost!
